The triples from \(\{B,C,E,F\}=\{160,180,200,310\}\) sum to  
\[
160+180+200=540,\quad 160+180+310=650,\quad 160+200+310=670,\quad 180+200+310=690.
\]
None equals \(680\), so \(A+D=340\) is invalid.

The valid case is \(150+180=330\) for the first shipment, and \(160+190+310=660=2\cdot330\) for the second shipment, leaving \(200\).

\[
\boxed{200}
\]
